title: Regioselective chemisorption-induced separate deposition of two types of metal nanoparticles on TiO2
author: Kiyonaga, Heima

steps.title: Photodeposit Pt on TiO2
steps.instruction: Load Pt nanoparticles onto anatase TiO₂ (A‑100, Ishihara Sangyo) by UV‑LED photodeposition.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 50 mL of 1.9 mM H₂PtCl₆ aqueous solution and disperse 2 g TiO₂ particles in it.
Irradiate the suspension with a 300‑390 nm UV LED (NCSU033B, Nichia) at an intensity of 7.0 mW cm⁻² until deposition is complete.
Wash the resulting TiO₂‑Pt particles by centrifugation three times with distilled water.
Dry the washed particles under vacuum.
Heat the dried TiO₂‑Pt in an Ar atmosphere at 600 °C for 20 h.

steps.title: Chemisorb Au onto TiO2‑Pt
steps.instruction: Attach Au³⁺ complexes to TiO₂‑Pt by pH‑controlled chemisorption.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 g TiO₂‑Pt to 5 mL of 2.43 mM HAuCl₄ solution.
Adjust the suspension to pH 6.0 with NaOH.
Stir and heat the mixture at 70 °C for 1 h.
Wash the Au‑chemisorbed particles three times with distilled water and dry under vacuum.

steps.title: Reduce Au⁺⁺ to Au⁰
steps.instruction: Convert the chemisorbed Au(III) ions to metallic Au nanoparticles.

substeps.instruction: Disperse the dried Au‑chemisorbed TiO₂‑Pt in 30 mL ethanol containing 48 mM NaBH₄.
Stir the suspension at 25 °C for 60 min.
Wash the resulting Au/TiO₂‑Pt repeatedly with distilled water and dry under vacuum.

steps.title: Prepare Comparative Au/TiO2 Sample
steps.instruction: Apply the chemisorption and reduction sequence of step 2 and step 3 to unmodified TiO₂ to obtain Au/TiO₂.

steps.title: Determine Metal Loading by ICP‑AES
steps.instruction: Quantify the wt % of Au and Pt on the prepared catalysts.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 50 mg of the catalyst (TiO₂‑Pt, Au/TiO₂‑Pt, or Au/TiO₂).
Digest the sample with 24 mL aqua regia.
Measure Au³⁺ and Pt⁴⁺ concentrations in the digest using an ICP‑AES (SPS 3500 DD, Hitachi).
Calculate loading wt % using: Loading ( wt % ) = [Concentration (mg L⁻¹) × 0.024 L / 50 mg] × 100.

steps.title: Measure Au Adsorption Isotherm
steps.instruction: Assess the amount of Au(III) complex chemisorbed on TiO₂ and TiO₂‑Pt.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 g of TiO₂ or TiO₂‑Pt to 5 mL of HAuCl₄ solution (concentration as used in step 2) and adjust to pH 6.0 with NaOH.
Stir and heat at 70 °C for 1 h to reach saturated chemisorption.
Wash the particles three times with distilled water and dry under vacuum.
Treat 50 mg of the washed sample with 24 mL aqua regia to release adsorbed Au(III).
Determine the released Au³⁺ concentration by ICP‑AES as in step 5.

steps.title: TEM Characterization
steps.instruction: Observe nanoparticle deposition by transmission electron microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Place a small amount of the catalyst on a TEM grid.
Image at an accelerating voltage of 200 kV using a JEM‑2100F (JEOL) microscope.

steps.title: XPS Analysis
steps.instruction: Confirm separate deposition of Au and Pt by X‑ray photoelectron spectroscopy.

substeps.instruction: Load the sample into a PHI Quantera II (Ulvac‑Phi) spectrometer equipped with monochromatic Al Kα radiation.
Calibrate binding energies to the C 1s peak at 284.8 eV.
Record Pt 4f spectra for Au/TiO₂‑Pt, TiO₂‑Pt, and bulk Pt foil.
